payload.title: Remove PAPYRUS_JWT_SECRET and the JWT authorizer; CLI authenticates with IAM (SigV4)
payload.description: Ryan decision 2026-10-06: no long-lived token anywhere in the Papyrus design. Delete PAPYRUS_JWT_SECRET, the custom JWT Lambda authorizer and refresh-jwt. The CLI and automation sign AppSync requests with SigV4 from the standard AWS credential chain (SSO, OIDC role, build role), authorized through a dedicated papyrus-authoring role created by infra/amplify-app-shell.
